summary: On 2026-04-14 Rahul Verma from Northwind emailed Farhan Sheikh (CISO) sending the SOC2 Type II report and a data residency note after a delay. Farhan thanked him and said the internal committee met on the 9th without the report, so the security review will move to the May decision cycle. He also mentioned that CFO Vikram Desai has been informed. The deal now awaits the May cycle decision.
